metadata.description: Blog creation and optimization tools for Claude Code

plugins.name: claude-blog
plugins.description: AI-powered blog creation, optimization, and management with 32 skill directories (1 orchestrator + 31 sub-skills), 5 agents, FLOW framework integration, semantic topic-cluster execution, multilingual publishing, brand and discourse context auto-load, and 5-category scoring. Optimized for Google rankings and AI citations.

plugins.name: blog-studio
plugins.description: Optional companion to claude-blog (needs claude-blog 2.3.2 or later): article status band, live pipeline and five-gate review panel, history of past blogs, and an explicit Run checks control. A Claude Code mod served from the blog-studio branch; install it separately.
